name: SEP Explorer
subtitle: On-site security estimating
promotionalText: Free Explorer tier — 10 projects, 50 catalog items, 20 labor rates.
description:
SEP Explorer is the free tier of Security Estimator Pro™ for security contractors.

Walk the site and capture:
• Projects with system counts (CCTV, doors, IDS, intercoms, cabling)
• Equipment catalog
• Labor rates that power every estimate
• Live material + labor + OH&P totals

Explorer limits (Free):
• 10 active projects
• 50 catalog records
• 20 labor records

Not included: drawing layouts, project management, or finance/invoicing.

Explore. Discover. Integrate.
reviewNotes: SEP Explorer is a free offline-capable estimating utility. No account login is required. Create a sample project from New Project to evaluate core flows. Document picker is used only for optional CSV equipment import.
